facts.fact: Two AI tutoring labs were launched on 21 September 2026 at Angra Pequena Senior Secondary School, a government school in Luderitz, where all 436 learners can access personalised tutoring and the 20 teachers have teaching-assistant support; YYeni AI says the programme was already operating before the launch, funded by BW Kudu and Namport.
